title: No-Fish No-Fee Fishing Guide Sevice
specs: Specializes in Northern Michigan Walleye fishing
Guiding on Lake Leelanau since 1994 with a natural reproducing Walleye population
Guiding on Houghton Lake since early 2000's with diverse fish species
Uses "Rod in Hand Approach" and cast jigging technique
A valid Michigan fishing license required
Trips based on 3 guests per boat; additional guests $50 each
Accommodates large groups and corporate outings; contact for prices
includes: All fishing equipment and fishing related gear

extraNote: No date is officially booked until confirmed by phone conversation
